from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """One company's cash flow item from its financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the report")
    cash_flow_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label for the cash flow (e.g., '购买商品、接受劳务支付的现金')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The amount value for the cash flow item")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period this report covers (e.g., '2024 Q1')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short excerpt showing the amount context")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_flows: list[CompanyCashFlow]
